cohort: The cohort consisted of 42 super-obese parturients (BMI >=50 kg/m2) undergoing cesarean delivery at Thailand's largest university hospital between 2014 and 2023.
finding: Super-obese parturients undergoing cesarean delivery experienced high rates of intraoperative hypotension (95.2%), postpartum hemorrhage (11.9%), and a moderate to high correlation between body weight and intraoperative blood loss.
